ex.en: I will notify you of the arrival of the goods.
ex.zh: 貨物到了，我會通知你們。

ex.en: Mass production reduced the price of many goods.
ex.zh: 大量生產降低了許多商品的價格。

ex.en: The government transported goods to the island by helicopter.
ex.zh: 政府用直升機把物資運到那座島上。

ex.en: Don't believe all the office gossip.
ex.zh: 別相信辦公室裡所有的八卦。

ex.en: She loves to hear the latest gossip.
ex.zh: 她很愛聽最新的八卦。

ex.en: The only time people dislike gossip is when you gossip about them.
ex.zh: 人們只有在你說他們閒話時，才會討厭八卦。

ex.en: They spent the whole lunch gossiping about their boss.
ex.zh: 他們整頓午餐都在聊老闆的八卦。

ex.en: Good corporate governance builds investor trust.
ex.zh: 良好的公司治理能建立投資人的信任。

ex.en: The board is responsible for the governance of the company.
ex.zh: 董事會負責公司的治理。

ex.en: We offered a discount as a gesture of goodwill.
ex.zh: 我們提供折扣以表達善意。

ex.en: The visit helped build goodwill between the two countries.
ex.zh: 這次訪問有助於增進兩國的友好關係。

ex.en: The company's goodwill is worth millions.
ex.zh: 這家公司的商譽價值數百萬。

ex.en: Poor service can damage a firm's goodwill.
ex.zh: 服務差會損害公司的商譽。

ex.en: Non-governmental organizations play an important role in disaster relief.
ex.zh: 非政府組織在救災中扮演重要角色。

ex.en: The project needs governmental approval.
ex.zh: 這個計畫需要政府核准。

ex.en: "Why aren't you going?" "Because I don't want to."
ex.zh: 「你為什麼不去？」「因為我不想去。」

ex.en: I go to the gym three times a week.
ex.zh: 我每週去健身房三次。

ex.en: How did the interview go?
ex.zh: 面試進行得怎麼樣？

ex.en: Everything went well at the meeting.
ex.zh: 會議一切順利。

ex.en: The milk has gone bad.
ex.zh: 牛奶壞掉了。

ex.en: Something went wrong with my computer.
ex.zh: 我的電腦出了點問題。

ex.en: The papers that were in the safe are gone.
ex.zh: 放在保險箱裡的文件不見了。

ex.en: My headache is finally gone.
ex.zh: 我的頭痛終於好了。

ex.en: I'm going to visit my parents this weekend.
ex.zh: 我這週末要去看我爸媽。

ex.en: It's going to be a busy week.
ex.zh: 這週會很忙。

ex.en: How are you? Did you have a good trip?
ex.zh: 你好嗎？旅途愉快嗎？

ex.en: This is a good restaurant for business lunches.
ex.zh: 這家餐廳很適合商務午餐。

ex.en: She is good at solving problems.
ex.zh: 她很擅長解決問題。

ex.en: I'm not good at math.
ex.zh: 我數學不好。

ex.en: Fresh vegetables are good for your health.
ex.zh: 新鮮蔬菜對健康有益。

ex.en: Walking is good for you.
ex.zh: 走路對你有好處。

ex.en: Exercise will do you good.
ex.zh: 運動對你有好處。

ex.en: It's no good complaining now.
ex.zh: 現在抱怨也沒用。

ex.en: The government transported goods to the island by helicopter.
ex.zh: 政府用直升機把物資運到那座島上。

ex.en: The goods will be delivered on Monday.
ex.zh: 這批貨將在星期一送達。

ex.en: The price of gold varies from day to day.
ex.zh: 金價每天都在變動。

ex.en: The color of gold is very similar to brass.
ex.zh: 金的顏色和黃銅很像。

ex.en: He was given a gold watch as a reward.
ex.zh: 他獲得一支金錶作為獎勵。

ex.en: Who do you think will win the gold medal?
ex.zh: 你們覺得誰會拿到金牌？

ex.en: The diamond was set in a gold ring.
ex.zh: 鑽石鑲在一枚金戒指上。

ex.en: Everybody wished he had been elected governor.
ex.zh: 大家都希望當初是他當選州長。

ex.en: The governor announced a new budget plan.
ex.zh: 州長宣布了新的預算計畫。

ex.en: The central bank governor spoke about interest rates.
ex.zh: 央行總裁談到了利率問題。

ex.en: She sits on the school's board of governors.
ex.zh: 她是學校理事會的成員。

ex.en: It depends what you mean by "believe" in God.
ex.zh: 這要看你所謂「相信」上帝是什麼意思。

ex.en: Many people pray to God for help.
ex.zh: 許多人向上帝祈求幫助。

ex.en: In Greek mythology, Ares was the god of war.
ex.zh: 在希臘神話中，阿瑞斯是戰神。

ex.en: After all, even the gods may err at times.
ex.zh: 畢竟，就連神也偶爾會犯錯。

ex.en: To govern a country is not an easy job.
ex.zh: 治理一個國家不是件容易的事。

ex.en: The king governed the country.
ex.zh: 國王統治這個國家。

ex.en: The most important feature of all games is that they are governed by rules.
ex.zh: 所有遊戲最重要的共同點，就是都受規則約束。

ex.en: Strict rules govern the use of personal data.
ex.zh: 個人資料的使用受到嚴格規範。

ex.en: He plays golf two or three times a month.
ex.zh: 他一個月打兩三次高爾夫球。

ex.en: Is there a golf course near here?
ex.zh: 這附近有高爾夫球場嗎？

ex.en: My mother can play golf very well.
ex.zh: 我媽媽高爾夫打得很好。

ex.en: Her golden hair floats in the summer breeze.
ex.zh: 她一頭金髮在夏日微風中飄動。

ex.en: He received a golden watch as a prize.
ex.zh: 他獲得一支金錶作為獎品。

ex.en: The fields turned golden in autumn.
ex.zh: 秋天田野變成一片金黃。

golden.zh: 寶貴的、黃金的（機會、時期）

ex.en: The Golden Age of the Romans is in the past.
ex.zh: 羅馬人的黃金時代已經過去了。

ex.en: This is a golden opportunity to expand our business.
ex.zh: 這是拓展業務的大好機會。

ex.en: The goat's milk that Mark sells is very popular among the locals.
ex.zh: 馬克賣的羊奶很受當地人歡迎。

ex.en: The farm has goats, sheep, and chickens.
ex.zh: 農場裡有山羊、綿羊和雞。

ex.en: We bought some goat cheese at the market.
ex.zh: 我們在市場買了一些羊乳酪。

ex.en: She did it out of the goodness of her heart.
ex.zh: 她是出於一片好心才這麼做的。

ex.en: I believe in the goodness of people.
ex.zh: 我相信人性本善。

ex.en: My goodness, look at the time!
ex.zh: 天啊，看看都幾點了！

ex.en: Goodness, you've grown so tall!
ex.zh: 天哪，你長得好高了！

ex.en: Thank goodness you're safe.
ex.zh: 謝天謝地，你平安無事。

ex.en: Thank goodness it's Friday.
ex.zh: 謝天謝地，終於星期五了。

ex.en: Few governments can manage the economy successfully.
ex.zh: 能把經濟管好的政府很少。

ex.en: The government transported goods to the island by helicopter.
ex.zh: 政府用直升機把物資運到那座島上。

ex.en: The government clearly stated its intention to lower taxes.
ex.zh: 政府明確表示打算減稅。

ex.en: The gourmet praised the chef"s use of regional ingredients.
ex.zh: 這位美食家稱讚主廚善用地方食材。

ex.en: A gourmet reviewed the new tasting menu for the magazine.
ex.zh: 一位美食家為雜誌評論了新推出的品嚐菜單。

ex.en: My goal in life is to be a novelist.
ex.zh: 我的人生目標是成為小說家。

ex.en: How do you plan to achieve the goals you set?
ex.zh: 你們打算怎麼達成你們設定的目標？

ex.en: I have made up my mind to achieve my goals in three years.
ex.zh: 我下定決心要在三年之內達成目標。

ex.en: In the last minute, Marcello scored an equalizing goal.
ex.zh: 最後一分鐘，馬塞洛踢進一球，把比分扳平。

ex.en: He scored two goals in the first half.
ex.zh: 他上半場進了兩球。
